title: Adversarial review findings
description: Passed to every codex call via --output-schema. Prose output is never parsed.

reviewed_path.description: Absolute path of the artefact reviewed. Recorded so proof of work can be re-run after the artefact moves or is renamed.

probe_echo.description: Verbatim text of the line numbers requested in the brief, chosen unpredictably at launch. Byte-exact.

probes_run.description: Stable probe ids from the rubric that this round actually ran. Used to check the convergence rule.

id.description: Reviewer's own label. Not authoritative — the adjudicator canonicalises identity from evidence.

scenario.description: Concrete: inputs or state, what happens, and the wrong outcome. Not an opinion about quality.

verbatim.description: Substring copied byte-for-byte from the cited line. Checked mechanically; a paraphrase fails.

falsifier.description: The observation that would prove this finding wrong. Required — it makes adjudication cheap and starves out unfalsifiable noise.

no_findings_reason.description: If findings is empty, why. A thin honest round is more useful than a padded one.
